2123895235063263728.en_summary: Nvidia Is Now Facing: 1. SEC investigation into potential accounting irregularities. 2. FBI investigation into Chinese intelligence operations involving Jensen Huang. 3. Allegations of Jensen Huang having an affair with a Chinese spy. 4. California investigation into allegedly misleading shareholders. 5. Criminal investigation into Megaspeed over export control violations. 6. Shareholder lawsuit over undisclosed ties between Jensen Huang and Megaspeed. 7. Congressional investigation into alleged interference with the Megaspeed probe. 8. Internal board investigation into national security and corporate governance failures. Just 14 days ago, none of these investigations had been publicly reported. ~40% of the market cap loss in the S&P 500 since its high is attributable to Nvidia, $NVDA. Talk about a turn of events.
2123895235063263728.zh_summary: Nvidia現在面臨：1. SEC對潛在會計違規的調查。2. FBI對涉及Jensen Huang的中國情報行動的調查。3. 指控Jensen Huang與中國間諜有婚外情。4. 加州對涉嫌誤導股東的調查。5. 對Megaspeed出口管制違規的刑事調查。6. 關於Jensen Huang與Megaspeed未披露關係的股東訴訟。7. 國會對涉嫌干預Megaspeed調查的調查。8. 內部董事會對國家安全和公司治理失敗的調查。就在14天前，這些調查都未公開報導。標普500自高點以來約40%的市值損失歸因於Nvidia，$NVDA。真是事態急轉直下。
